| image    = Faith.png

| source   = [[Sermons]], [[Confessional]]
| study    =

Faith is a resource that can be obtained either through holding [[sermons]] on {{day|pride}} or occasionally at random from a [[confessional]]. Later in the game, you can also obtain some faith at the [[Buffet tent|burnings]].

Faith is required to study most objects in the [[study table]] as well as for some [[NPCs|NPC]] interactions. It is used in crafting [[sermons]], [[Stone cutter II|advanced stone works]] and {{Item|Zombie}}s.
{{clear}}

==Quests==
* [[Snake]] requires {{Item|Faith|5}} before he will interact with the player.
* [[Ms. Charm]] wants {{Item|Faith|5}} before really talking to the player.
